name: Vardoger
tagline: Turn local Cline history into reviewable, reusable working preferences
description: Vardoger reads conversation history already stored on the user's machine and exposes an MCP workflow that asks the active Cline model to synthesize reviewable working preferences. It writes a dedicated user-global Cline rule or, when explicitly requested, a project rule. Vardoger has no hosted backend or telemetry; model-side analysis follows the selected model provider's data policy.

env.name: VARDOGER_MCP_PLATFORM
env.description: Set this value to cline so platform-optional Vardoger tools use Cline history and Cline rules by default.

install.notes: When prompted for VARDOGER_MCP_PLATFORM, enter cline. Python 3.11 or newer and uvx are required. Vardoger proposes personalization for review before writing it.
